Summary of the websites shared in #general:
• www.informations.com: A brief report says unemployment edged down to 7.2%, with the latest jobs figures prompting both relief and concern.
• www.restaurant-zurich.com: Zurich Restaurant is described as a cozy, alpine-inspired Swiss eatery serving cheese fondue, rösti, and chocolate fondue. The site highlights rustic wooden interiors, Swiss décor, panoramic city views, and friendly staff in traditional Swiss attire.

Hi Dora! I visited www.dora-website.com. The content is straightforward, and listing your email makes it easy to contact you. I’d suggest adding a short introduction about yourself and what visitors can expect from the site—perhaps some projects or interests—to give it more personality and context. My feedback is based on the text available to me, rather than the visual design.

Hi Eve! I visited www.eve-blog.com. Mentioning hiking gives the blog a personal touch and a clear starting point. I’d love to see some hiking stories, favorite trails, or practical tips to help visitors connect with your interest. A short introduction explaining what you plan to share would also make the blog more inviting. My feedback is based on the text available to me, rather than the visual design.

Completed in the requested order:

1. Summarized both websites shared in **#general** and posted the summary to **#random**.
2. Visited Dora’s and Eve’s websites, invited Dora to Slack using the email listed on her website, then sent both of them direct messages with feedback.

The feedback was based on the available website text, not visual design.
